summary: It's a Wonderful World is a card-drafting engine builder where every player drafts from the same rotating hand simultaneously, then decides whether to recycle each card for immediate resources or build it for ongoing production and points. The simultaneous draft-and-plan structure keeps downtime low even though most of the actual building happens in parallel on personal empire boards.
praised: clever simultaneous drafting keeps everyone engaged
criticised: mostly parallel play with limited direct interaction
some randomness in which cards appear
feels similar to 7 Wonders/Res Arcana to experienced gamers

interaction.kind: mostly parallel drafting and engine building
interaction.detail: Players see and pass around the same pool of cards, so they can deny each other specific cards by drafting them first, but production, resources, and scoring all live on each player's own empire board with almost no direct conflict.

scoring.why: Final score adds up printed points on built development cards, empire-wide bonuses/multipliers, leftover resources, and achievement thresholds.
scoring.how_you_win: Draft cards each round, choose which to recycle for resources and which to construct into your Empire for ongoing production and points, then finish with the highest combined score from your buildings, resources, and bonuses.
